# nanoflags_flag (Resource)

A feature flag: its key, type and details. Per-environment targeting lives in `nanoflags_flag_environment`.

Creating a flag puts it in every environment's draft with `initial_value`; nothing is published. The Management API has no hard delete: **destroying this resource archives the flag** (it leaves published revisions on the next publish). Because keys are permanent, an archived key cannot be created again; import it and set `archived = false` instead.

Scopes: `flags:read`, `flags:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A boolean release flag, served to browser and mobile keys.
resource "nanoflags_flag" "new_checkout" {
  project        = "web"
  key            = "new-checkout"
  name           = "New checkout"
  description    = "Rebuilt checkout flow"
  client_exposed = true
  review_date    = "2027-03-01"
}

# A string flag: initial_value is required and must match the type.
resource "nanoflags_flag" "accent_color" {
  project       = "web"
  key           = "accent-color"
  type          = "string"
  purpose       = "experiment"
  initial_value = jsonencode("blue")
}

# A json flag whose values must satisfy a JSON Schema.
resource "nanoflags_flag" "upload_limits" {
  project       = "web"
  key           = "upload-limits"
  type          = "json"
  purpose       = "operational"
  permanent     = true
  initial_value = jsonencode({ max_mb = 10 })
  json_schema = jsonencode({
    type       = "object"
    required   = ["max_mb"]
    properties = { max_mb = { type = "number", minimum = 1 } }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Flag key used in code, e.g. `new-checkout`. Immutable: changing it creates a new flag and archives the old one.
- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Archive the flag (removed from every draft). Default `false`.
- `client_exposed` (Boolean) Serve this flag to browser and mobile (`nf_pub_…`) keys. Default `false`.
- `description` (String) Description, at most 2000 characters.
- `initial_value` (String) JSON-encoded value every environment's draft starts with, e.g. `jsonencode(false)`. Required for `string`, `number` and `json` flags; `false` for boolean flags. Only used at creation: change per-environment values with `nanoflags_flag_environment`.
- `json_schema` (String) JSON-encoded JSON Schema (an object) that the values of a `json` flag must satisfy.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters. Defaults to the key.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner (member id, UUID). Defaults to the token's creator.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Long-lived flag that is meant to stay in code (excluded from stale-flag cleanup). Default `false`.
- `purpose` (String) `release` (default), `experiment`, `operational` or `permission`.
- `review_date` (String) Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) by which the flag should be reviewed or removed.
- `type` (String) Value type: `boolean` (default), `string`, `number` or `json`. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) When the flag was archived.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Flag id (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project key>/<flag key>
terraform import nanoflags_flag.new_checkout web/new-checkout
```
